messages:
marta: heads-up — buildkite CI on main is red after last night's infra image roll. bazel build //libs/crypto:crypto fails with missing dep. full snippet below.

marta: ```
ERROR: /workspace/libs/crypto/BUILD:12:1: in cc_library rule //libs/crypto:crypto: label '//third_party/crypto:core' in deps does not refer to a package; perhaps 'third_party/crypto' is missing a BUILD file?
Target //libs/crypto:crypto failed to build
INFO: Elapsed time: 1.23s
```

ben: ack. which shard/config? flaky or consistent across shards?

marta: consistent on linux-gcc and linux-clang shards. reproduced locally with bazelisk.

lia: can you run `bazel query 'deps(//libs/crypto:crypto)'` and paste output? might show where the label points.

marta: ran it, returns everything up to //third_party/crypto:core then stops — looks like that package isn't present in the workspace.

sam: does `ls third_party/crypto` show a BUILD file? maybe repo rename removed it.

marta: `ls` shows `core/` and `bindings/` dirs but no BUILD or BUILD.bazel at the top.

ben: we had a third_party cleanup in the repo rename PR last week that moved some BUILD files into subdirs. maybe an alias was supposed to be added and wasn't. cc @eng-infra

devops: I can bisect the infra image roll, but first is this a source-level change (missing BUILD) or a runtime change (toolchain complaining about ABI)? sounds like source-level (BUILD gone).

lia: if the BUILD moved into `core/BUILD` someone needed an alias at `third_party/crypto/BUILD` with `exports_files` or `filegroup` to keep the old label working.

marta: temporary workaround: updating libs/crypto/BUILD to point at //third_party/crypto/core:core_target works locally, but that's a bandaid.

ben: can you push a tiny PR to restore an alias BUILD in third_party/crypto that references core? we can hotfix master quickly. then we can follow up with a proper rename migration.

marta: I can open PR now. will include test/CI check.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by ben — queueing rebuild (job id 8423).

sam: if you open the PR, @devops can hold the revert/bisect in case the image roll also revealed it.

devops: sounds good. I'll stand by to bisect if the rebuild still fails after the alias fix.

marta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/fix/third_party-crypto-alias (small BUILD alias + test). requesting review from @ben and @lia.

ben: reviewing now, will merge if green. :thumbsup:

lia: nit: add a short comment in the commit message referencing the repo-rename PR that caused the movement so we can track.

marta: done. merged after green.

ci-bot: Build succeeded for job id 8423 — master green.

ben: thanks all. follow-up: let's add a CI lint that checks for missing top-level BUILD files for third_party packages to avoid future regressions. filing a ticket.

marta: filed TICKET-1423 for the lint. closing this thread.
